verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web-data and brand API, so a sandbox or test-mode environment is a fair axis, but the evidence documents no sandbox, test keys or isolated test environment. Restricted API keys limit which operations a key can call, which is an adjacent permission control rather than sandbox isolation. Partial-result timeouts are likewise not a dry-run or test mode.
